reason: An unofficial DSH Web theme that changes visual styling, responsive panel layout, and mascot animations while adding a read-only public news drawer; the README states it targets only the web profile and does not modify session data or core packages.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供非官方主题、响应式布局、角色状态动画和可选的公开新闻抽屉。
summaries.en: An unofficial DeepSeek Harness Web theme providing responsive layout styling, mascot state animations, and an optional public news drawer.

capabilities: Changes the DSH Web interface theme, layout, and animations
Reads public Endfield news through a read-only proxy route and caches limited results
